title: Taxpayer baselines and peer-group intelligence
scope: Generate explainable baseline/peer comparisons with minimum sample and data-quality guards

acceptance.text: Generate explainable baseline/peer comparisons with minimum sample and data-quality guards
Small or biased samples yield insufficient-evidence state; unusual behavior is not a fraud conclusion
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Small or biased samples yield insufficient-evidence state; unusual behavior is not a fraud conclusion

evidence.text: ai/workflows/peer_baselines.py compare (TAX-053 read-access check first) gives explainable comparisons of one taxpayer-period against its own history (>=4 earlier periods) and against peers in the same sector, size band and period (>=10): Decimal ratios refund/turnover and input VAT/turnover, nearest-rank median/Q1/Q3, IQR typical range, percentile rank, direction and a plain-language explanation with n and data-quality notes. Guards: minimum samples, >20% data-quality exclusions (incomplete, amended-unreconciled, unverified source), >80% of peers from one region, undefined ratios. Aggregates only; thresholds documented as prototype choices.

tests/ai/test_peer_baselines.py (10 tests): explainable comparison (subject 0.1500 vs 12 peers, percentile 100.0, outside_typical_range, own baseline n=4); exact Decimal robust stats where one outlier does not move the median; 9 peers and 2 history periods -> insufficient_evidence (peer_sample_too_small, history_sample_too_small) with no statistics returned; 4 of 15 unverified peers -> data_quality_exclusions_too_high; 11 of 12 peers from one region -> peer_group_skewed_by_region; zero turnover -> subject_undefined_ratio; peers matched only on sector/size/period. Outside-range results carry alternative explanations; risk_score and fraud_conclusion null; no peer identifiers in output; taxpayer callers and malformed/duplicate/cross-tenant input refused. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 279 passed; ruff/mypy (204 files) pass.
